summary: Customize town & Run a city life - Play together with friends all the city games
description:
Run a City and manage a city life. Get street upgrades and customize characters. 8 new locations to discover and 40 areas to customize. Create your own mini world. Play together with friends and explore all playhouses!

Play city games, run a city life and meet all the citizens. Explore a mini world and have fun for hours! Create and play your stories.

MY TOWN CITY GAMES – BUILD A CITY LIFE

Have you ever dreamed of running a city life with its citizens? Would you like to build a town with your rules? 

Welcome to the My Town City simulator, where you can run a city life and roleplay city stories your way! Discover a huge map, build a town by unlocking new playhouses and create your own mini world. Mega Town is constantly growing! There are always new playhouses that you can add. Build a City life story and fulfill your citizen's wishes!

RUN A CITY LIFE – EXPLORE YOUR MINI WORLD

Create and play a big party, visit a dance stage or go shopping. Create and play city games together with friends on the same map! Invite them to visit your mini world, enjoy all city games and run a city life with your rules! Build city stories and customize buildings! Decide how your mega town will look alike. Create and play urban city games and explore a Megapolis. Build your own city and roleplay city games with friends!

MY TOWN CITY GAMES – DISCOVER ALL THE FUN

Build your own City rules and play together with friends! Run a city, create your mini world and interact with everything! Is your character hungry? Take him to a restaurant! Each playhouse has something new to offer! Visit My Town Mini World and play fun city games all day. Decide how your mini world will look and run a city life. Build the town of your dreams!

Explore all playhouses, make a pool party or hang out on the streets. You choose! Meet all the characters, discover all playhouses and create urban city stories! My Town city games for kids!

CREATE AND PLAY CITY STORIES

8+ playhouses unlocked! Customize characters in this mega town as you like. Roleplay urban city life stories all day. Set your rules and add new playhouses and streets to the mega town. Explore your mini world and play your favorite playhouse games. Play city games on the street and meet your neighbors! You run this city!

MY TOWN – BUILD A CITY LIFE & ENJOY CITY GAMES:

•	Run a city life, create and play your stories
•	8 NEW locations to discover
•	40 areas to customize - build a city of your dreams
•	Discover & Play urban city stories
•	Explore all playhouses in this mini world
•	Customize characters
•	Build your own city rules
•	Enjoy city games with citizens
•	Collect HEARTS – your town currency
•	Fulfill the character's wishes to get gifts
•	Play together with friends on the same device
•	Play mini-games
•	Your Mini World - your rules
•	My Town City games for kids of all ages.

Mega Town never stops growing! Check updates for new mega town locations. Build a city life! Get new features every time you visit your mini world. Build a town and enjoy all mini-games.

MAKE CHARACTERS WISHES COME TRUE!

My Town City game new feature. Fulfill your character's wishes and get Hearts - your city game currency. Use them to unlock gift boxes and mega town upgrades! Build a city life stories you like and play together with friends!

Create and play city games with town citizens. Discover all the fun in this mini world! Build your own city life stories, set your rules and make citizens happy!

MY TOWN CITY GAMES FOR KIDS

Visit a Mini World SCIENCE MUSEUM and learn how to make a paper airplane! Roleplay city games and learn new things every day! My Town city games are so fun! Build a city story you like!

Build your own city stories and run a city life! Set your rules! Build the town of your dreams!

ABOUT MY TOWN GAMES

The My Town Games studio designs digital roleplay dollhouse games that promote kids' creativity. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania, and Philippines. For help visit www.my-town.com
